title: Aggressive helicopter experiment where everything went wrong
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Aggressive helicopter experiment where everything went wrong, about c. 2024 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we had an experiment that we were running that was really aggressive and everything went wrong.

plain: Brandon Fugal, a businessman who owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange lights and events, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an experiment there around 2024 that used a helicopter. He says it was a really aggressive experiment and that everything went wrong. He tells it as evidence that something at the ranch reacts when it is pushed.
